meta.phase: Expo MVP core loop; UX polish pass on chat, search, deadlines

expo_go_notes: Core JS screens can run in Expo Go.
Native document scanner, custom URL schemes, OAuth redirects, and password reset links should be tested in a development build.
Document scanner uses lazy dynamic import + TurboModuleRegistry.get('DocumentScanner') guard so app loads cleanly in Expo Go and only the scanner button errors when pressed.
added_packages_this_session: yaml ^2.9.0 (parse bundled terms.yaml for the Terms of Service screen)
mobile_runtime.metro_config: metro.config.js extends the default Expo config to add 'yaml' and 'yml' to resolver.assetExts so .yaml content can be bundled and loaded via expo-asset; src/types/assets.d.ts declares the matching '*.yaml' module so TS imports resolve.

local_environment.secrets_policy: STATUS.json intentionally does not store anon key or other secrets.

stack.sse: custom fetch stream parser in src/lib/sse.ts
stack.styling: React Native StyleSheet + shared color tokens in src/components/ui.tsx

root.purpose: Safe area, locale provider, auth provider, root Stack with scan/[id] and scan/new pushed over tabs; iOS edge-swipe back enabled here

tabs.purpose: Bottom tab shell: documents, deadlines, help, profile; Android nav-bar themed via expo-navigation-bar

tabs.screen: Help home — popular categories, quick action chips, CTA to scan
Help search — full-text search across guides
Help category — list of guides in one category
Help guide — single article with sections (text/steps/checklist/warning/cta), sticky CTA footer, optional official source URL
Privacy — data overview + delete all scans

tabs.notes: Loads localized terms content from bundled src/features/profile/terms.yaml via expo-asset + yaml parser; falls back to cs when current locale is missing.

Lets the user look up an OAMP (Czech immigration office) case by řízení number or visa number; calls POST /status/oamp on the backend which scrapes the OAMP public portal and returns {kind, status, message, ...}. Outcome shown with tone-mapped icon/title and localized body.

scan.notes: moved to root Stack so iOS edge swipe-back works
key={id} on ChatThreadScreen forces remount to avoid previous-chat flash

ui_contains: ThemeProvider syncs Android navigation bar via expo-navigation-bar
components.action_sheet: Reusable iOS-style bottom sheet (Modal + slide). Accepts title/subtitle/actions[]; supports destructive style and Ionicons. Used by DeadlinesScreen long-press menu.
components.paywall_sheet: Custom Modal scaffold — SDK wiring deferred (RevenueCat).
components.icon: src/components/Icon.tsx — thin wrapper around Ionicons used for inline glyphs (e.g. eye toggle in password fields).
components.auth_gradient: src/components/AuthGradient.tsx — radial/linear gradient background shared by AuthScreen and ResetPasswordScreen.
components.brand_mark: src/components/BrandMark.tsx — BrandWordmark SVG logo used on auth screens.
components.app_icon: src/components/AppIcon.tsx — custom SVG icon set (doc-text, calendar, user, lock, shield, trash, info, …) used throughout the app.

redirects.password_reset: generated by expo-linking, printed as Password reset redirect URL in Metro logs

scans.pinned_scans_store: src/features/scans/pinnedScansStore.ts — persisted list of pinned scan IDs; pinned items appear at top of scan list.

chat.chat_thread_cache: chatThreadCache.ts — in-memory Map keyed by scan_id; caches loaded threads so reopening a chat is instant; invalidateChatCache() called on deleteAllScans to prevent stale data.

deadlines.ux_state: v2 design tokens applied (warm-paper light + dark). Long-press opens shared ActionSheet for edit/delete/mark-done. Swipe gestures retained as alternative.

responsibilities: authorized API fetch — fetch-throw caught and surfaced as common.networkError; 5xx and unknown proxy error envelopes (Railway/fly.io `{ status, code, message }`) collapsed to common.serviceDown so the raw envelope never leaks into UI
SSE parsing — same offline / service-down normalization applied to streamed error frames
RevenueCat configure/identify/clear wrapped with Expo Go + missing-module guards

features.status_outcome_tone_mapping: approved | processing | not_found | rejected | found | unknown

features.terms_localized_yaml: cs/ru/uk/en stored together in terms.yaml; locale fallback to cs

explicitly_deferred: Apple Sign In until Apple Developer account setup is complete

redirect_urls: the exact Password reset redirect URL printed by Metro when pressing forgot password
supabase_auth.password_reset: requires redirect URL allowlist and testing from mobile app environment, not desktop Chrome

google_cloud_required: Client ID and Client Secret copied into Supabase Google provider
Supabase callback URL added to Google authorized redirect URIs

apple_sign_in.reason: Requires paid Apple Developer Program and Sign in with Apple capability.
expected_next_steps: Enable Sign in with Apple capability for app.jasne.mobile
Add expo-apple-authentication back if native Apple auth is desired

ios_signing.physical_device: requires Xcode signing certificate and trusted developer profile
ios_signing.error_seen: No code signing certificates are available to use.

scan pending screen opens and shows progress/errors

bug_fixes_applied.fix: Wrap new URL(url) in try/catch — malformed deep-link URLs no longer crash the app on startup
signOut rewritten as proper async function (was .then() fire-and-forget)
completeOAuthRedirect wraps new URL() in try/catch — returns error string instead of throwing
Extract compareDeadlines to module level so edit-modal sort matches load and markDone order
Add aliveRef + cleanup useEffect to prevent setState after unmount on slow network
Replace pendingDoneHandled state with useRef — eliminates stale closure bug in SSE event listener
Add alive flags in both useEffects to prevent setState after unmount
Make onOpenViewer optional on DocumentAttachmentBubble — crash with multiple images fixed
Move SHEET_HIDDEN constant to module level (was re-created on every render)
Add aliveRef + cleanup to prevent setState after unmount in loadLimits
Add aliveRef + bail-out in load callback to prevent setState after unmount
Rewrote lightColors palette with v2 design tokens (warm paper bg, deeper amber/danger/green/pro) and added bgDeep / surface3 / borderSoft to both schemes for type parity
Footer background changed from hardcoded rgba(15,13,11,0.94) to colors.bg so light theme no longer shows a black chat bar
Urgency pill now uses three-tone helper (urgent < 7d red, soon ≤ 30d amber, later green) instead of always red
LockedChatComposer split into free (paywall CTA) vs pro-exhausted (counter) renderings; receives plan and real questionsUsed instead of duplicate displayQuestionLimit

KeyboardAvoidingView now wraps the full content area (FlatList + footer in normal flow) so messages compress and footer pins above the keyboard; previously absolute footer caused messages to hide under the keyboard
Keyboard listener resets footer paddingBottom when keyboard is open so the input pill sits flush against the keyboard with no safe-area gap

Platform-aware footer padding: iOS max(insets.bottom, 10) for home indicator, Android raw insets.bottom; KeyboardAvoidingView behavior undefined on Android to avoid double-resize with system adjustResize
Per-scan in-memory scrollOffset Map + onScroll/onContentSizeChange handlers restore scroll position when reopening a chat and only auto-scroll on new tokens when user is near bottom
Route key={params.id} forces a fresh mount on scan change, eliminating the flash of the previous chat's data while the new one loads
Sync Android system navigation bar background and button style with current theme via expo-navigation-bar useEffect
Platform-aware tab bar paddingBottom — iOS uses safe area for home indicator, Android clamps to ≤8pt to avoid wasted space under gesture nav
Moved scan/[id] and scan/new from Tabs to root Stack so iOS edge swipe-back gesture works; animation slide_from_right
Replaced broken hand-drawn search/bell glyph Views with Ionicons; removed bell entirely; search now inline in AppBar with Cancel button and LayoutAnimation transition
Added SearchEmpty state, amber-highlight on matched substrings in title/sender/summary, and extended filterScans to match against linked deadline title/description
Restored FAB camera button (was missing from JSX though style existed); DocCard now shows sender line and uses v2 border + soft shadow
Card date split into day (Geist 24) + month (Inter 14) baseline-aligned; description hidden when done; new compact ux still pending
Long-press on card triggers shared ActionSheet (edit / delete destructive / mark-done) with 15ms haptic; PanResponder swipes retained as alternative
Added searchClearAria, searchEmptyTitle, searchEmptyDetail across cs/ru/uk/en; cleaned duplicate deadlines.markDone keys
Added src/lib/purchases.ts — RevenueCat wrapper with configure/identify/clear, all guarded by Expo Go + dynamic-import detection so missing native module never crashes JS bundle
configurePurchases() runs once on mount (idempotent) so RevenueCat is ready before sign-in screen renders
On session arrival useEffect aliases RevenueCat to session.user.id; signOut calls clearPurchasesIdentity BEFORE supabase.auth.signOut so next user on device doesn't inherit purchases
fetch() wrapped in try/catch — DNS/TLS/CORS failures now throw a localized common.networkError ApiError(status=0) instead of an opaque TypeError

Error-body normalizer collapses 5xx, empty bodies, non-JSON bodies, and platform-proxy envelopes (Railway/fly.io `{ status, code, message, request_id }`) to localized common.serviceDown — UI no longer shows 'Application not found' or raw JSON
Password fields gained an eye toggle (auth.showPassword / auth.hidePassword) and a proper AppIcon `lock` glyph replacing the typographic `•`
'Podmínky používání' row and footer link now navigate to /profile/terms; footer Privacy link now also routes to /profile/privacy

Added Terms of Service screen rendered from bundled terms.yaml (locales cs/ru/uk/en, fallback cs); metro.config.js extends assetExts with yaml/yml, src/types/assets.d.ts declares the *.yaml module shape
invalidateChatCache() called after deleteAllScans so stale chat threads do not flash on next entry
Tab icon wrapped in fixed-height 26pt slot so Ionicons help-circle aligns on the same baseline as AppIcon docs/calendar/user glyphs

Empty state gained an optional hero icon and a filled primary CTA; HelpErrorState now uses common.offlineTitle / common.offlineDetail / common.tryAgain with alert-circle-outline hero, matching the new offline UX language
Added getScanCounts() helper for new GET /scans/counts endpoint (total + by_category)
